title: Frontend: Captcha Generator
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Captcha Generator. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App({challenges=[AB12,CD34]}). Show current [data-testid=challenge]. Answer input plus Verify[data-action=verify] reports Correct/Incorrect in [data-testid=feedback], trimming and uppercasing. Regenerate cycles and clears input/feedback; an old challenge answer must fail. This client demo is inspectable and not an abuse boundary.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Generate a new challenge only when requested and compare the answer using the declared normalization policy.
alternativeApproaches: Design an accessible server-validated alternative rather than obscuring text more aggressively.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Regenerate; answer for old challenge; case policy.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
